title: HiveFront - After first 2 days dev
author: Defiant-Balance-7982
selftext:
Inspired by the late launch of the just announced Starcraft Shooter game in 2030 I decided to have so fun with game dev myself. 

I am a die hard Claude user and this is my first test with Open AI Astra + Meshy for the models.  
Current state took my 60% of weekly usage but mainly because I started off with Astra Extra High. 

Music made with free Suno account.   
  
Current state is a full 3 round waves followed by an extraction round where you need to protect the pick up point.

The combination of having chatgpt design assets then throw them into meshy for 3d models and back into astra which optimizes them in Blender feels really amazing.

comments.author: SupMekBots
comments.body: Looks really solid for just two days. What are you using for the 3D assets — custom models or an asset pack?

replies.author: Defiant-Balance-7982
replies.body: OpenAI imagegen into [meshy.ai](http://meshy.ai) for modelling. Which model do you use to write reddit comments?

replies.author: SupMekBots
replies.body:
Fair question :D   
  
I use ChatGPT sometimes to help polish my English, but the questions are genuinely mine. I’m also building a digital card game with AI tools. Will show it later.  
  
For my 3D, I usually use Tripo, somehow I get better results from it than Meshy or Hunyuan 3D.

replies.author: Defiant-Balance-7982
replies.body: Planning on trying out Tripo as well. But there are so many 3D model AI companies popping up everywhere

replies.author: SupMekBots
replies.body:
Yeah, honestly I think we need more AI tools for animation and VFX   
  
That’s probably one of the biggest missing pieces in AI game dev right now, and it would complement the rest of the workflow really well

replies.author: Xijamk
replies.body: I've both, tripo is by far better and the top 1, what did you use to animate the zergs?

replies.author: Defiant-Balance-7982
replies.body: Astra did the entire animation itself in Blender

comments.author: ChadSexman
comments.body:
The skyline and atmosphere is beautiful.

I realize it’s probably placeholder, but please spend some more time on audio. Your gun shots sound like a CVS printer.

replies.author: Defiant-Balance-7982
replies.body: Haha thanks and agreed, the gun shots have now already been improved they were terrible audio generated by Astra itself.

comments.author: ArialBear
comments.body: 2 days? oh man youre inspiring me to at least get started on my project. Insane work

replies.author: Defiant-Balance-7982
replies.body: Thanks! Keep your project small at first, create the best quality you can then expand from there if you want is what I recommend :)

comments.author: Sylvers
comments.body: Did you target a specific poly count for your Meshy assets?

replies.author: Defiant-Balance-7982
replies.body: No, by example the two enemy models were 1.3 million from Meshy. Astra optimized these in Blender to 30k each.
